supervisor_sizing.reason: Cheap on the build (12x NTM) with insider buying (Form 4s, code P: CEO 850 shares at $296.76 on 2026-09-09, directors 700 at $286.92 on 09-01 and 350 at $280.62 on 09-23 [30-32]; the 10-07 Form 4 is tax withholding [33] and a Form 144 notice of proposed sale was filed 10-05), but the stock is very volatile (-61% from the high), carries carrier concentration and an earnings print within a month, so its Sharpe beating SPY is slightly less likely than not. A 4% cap keeps a downside-case loss near 2% of the portfolio.

method: Suggested allocation from the cash to deploy: one joint solve over every name (optimize.py), run after combine.py.
